svg.title: Physical contract and experimental antecedents. This ordinary Markovian one-excitation model assumes preparable modes, fixed calibrated couplings, initially unexcited absorber/bath, a specified interaction picture and clock, persistent orthogonal flag records, and retained nominated source/controller and null/loss records. These are introduced physical assumptions. An optical Hamiltonian alternative, Hint = ħg(arb† + a† rb) with ar = P x r∗ xax and vacuum output b, gives Econverted = sin2(gT)Π on the one-photon sector. Coherent conversion and irreversible exponential absorption are different controlled models. Ansari et al. [2], Sec. II Eqs. (1)–(7), supply an actual shaped-pump conversion Hamiltonian and measurement operator P k ηk|k⟩⟨k|. Serino et al. [10], Secs. II–III and V–VI, demonstrate a five-dimensional multi-output decoder and six MUB settings. This is a calibration platform, not evidence for a microtubule or ontological identification. No new fundamental dynamics is proposed. The instrument here declares registered classical time/label outputs and the residual source and nominated inert reference. It does not identify the microscopic coherent bath outputs of two different implementations. A stronger retained-output comparison must include the bath in both laws and is not established here.
